description: An error type is an enum (§19.1, §14.2 — there is no `:error` kind), and its variants carry data as payload fields. A payload field named `message` or `type` is legal: no normative text reserves them, and E-ERROR-008 is retired. The declaration compiles clean.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — S479 batch items 1 and 2, PA recs adopted" item 1 — rewritten from `type MyError : error = { reason : string , code : int }` (error/error-008-message-pos retired with E-ERROR-008).
rationale: §19.1: 'Error types are enum types (§14.4). Error variants are enum variants.' The ruling's capable alternative to the struck `:error` kind: 'payload fields on variants (`Failed(message: string)`); authors lose nothing.'
